name: mcp-prompts
description: A prompt library with templates. Skills find, fill and save prompts; settings add your own folder, default tags, a preferred language and a shared catalog.

registry.title: Package registry
registry.description: Where the server package comes from. github needs the token below; npm needs no token and is the one that works in cloud sessions. Both serve the same build.

github_token.title: GitHub token (read:packages)
github_token.description: A personal access token (classic) with the read:packages scope. Used only with the github registry; GitHub asks for one even for public packages.

prompts_dir.title: Your prompts folder
prompts_dir.description: A folder of your own prompt JSON files, loaded on top of the bundled prompts (yours win on the same id). The save-prompt skill writes here.

default_tags.title: Default tags
default_tags.description: Comma-separated tags the skills search unless you name others, for example mia-dev.

language.title: Preferred language
language.description: When a prompt exists in more than one language, prefer this one (from the prompt's metadata.language).

catalog_url.title: Shared catalog URL
catalog_url.description: An https URL of a JSON catalog of prompts (for example on GitHub Pages), loaded at start. If it fails, the bundled prompts stay.
